Game Overview

Balls will Fall puts players into a hyper-casual experience centered on dodge an endless rain of balls in this fast-paced arcade adventure. Sharpen your reflexes and devise strategies to outmaneuver cascading spheres. Survive as long as you can while enjoying a clean aesthetic and addictive scoring. Challenge yourself to beat your highest score and embrace the thrill!
